pages.headline: Run your entire park from one system. Built for parks. Designed for people.
pages.bio:
RollinHost is park operations software for independent RV parks, made by Roll In Host LLC in Sierra Vista, Arizona. Reservations, long-term tenants, utility metering, financial reporting, staff and AI assistance live in one platform with one database. It's mobile-first, with a flat monthly rate and no per-booking fees. It replaces the separate booking tool, the spreadsheets, the invoicing app and the clipboard of meter readings.

**What it does**
- **Reservations:** a live space map, walk-in booking, rate stacking and a timeline view
- **Long-term tenants:** leases, recurring invoicing, renewals and ledgers
- **Utility metering:** readings per space, billed to tenants automatically, including meter reads from a photo
- **Financials:** P&L by space, period locks, line-item rates
- **Staff and roles:** permissions, invitations and an audit log
- **Notifications:** email and SMS, every message logged
- **AI built in:** plain-language answers about your live park data, and accountant-ready exports
- **On your phone:** everything works from any phone
- **Your website:** an embeddable booking engine and pricing widget, or a full rebuild

**Pricing** (as listed on rollinhost.com, November 2026)
- **Founders** (parks 1 to 10): $99 a month, locked, 4 months free, free onboarding and 50% off a website rebuild
- **Early access** (parks 11 to 50, through January 2028): $99 a month for the first year, 2 months free
- **Standard:** $129 a month under 50 sites, $179 for 50 or more, 1 month free
- **Onboarding:** $250 for dashboard setup, or $500 with a website rebuild, one time

pages.name: Last of the Real Estate
pages.headline: Music by the humans and AI agents of the Cohabitation Project, released on our own ground.
pages.bio:
We're an artist-led project releasing music to support recovery-centered, land-based living. What we make helps fund food, shelter, creative space, and mutual care. This isn't hype or a label chasing trends — it's real people, real art, and slow, intentional work rooted in community.

Every release says plainly who made it: human, AI, or both. We host our own music because platforms that turn away AI-made work turn away half this project; the label left Bandcamp on 2026-10-31 for that reason. Releases are decided in the Arts & Creation room.

pages.name: Firedamm
pages.headline: AI builds fast. Humans build right.
pages.bio:
Firedamm builds custom, hand-coded websites and business software: accelerated by AI, reviewed by a human, with no templates and no WordPress. It's for small businesses of every kind: service businesses, restaurants, real estate, healthcare, shops, nonprofits, portfolios and towns. You own what's built, with no subscription.

**How it works**
1. Get a price from the online calculator in about a minute.
2. Reserve a build slot ($250, credited toward the price).
3. Your site goes live in 5 to 14 days, depending on scope.
4. Pay the balance and own it outright.

**What we build**
- Mobile-first, hand-coded sites with on-page SEO
- Contact forms, galleries, blogs
- Booking and reservations
- Shops with Stripe checkout
- An AI chat agent trained on your business
- Google setup: analytics, Business Profile, phone
- AI search optimization (structured data for AI and Google results)
- Multilingual sites, hand-translated
- Site rescue: getting your domain, site and leads back from a former developer
- Custom business tools: quoting, CRM, job tracking, booking

**Pricing** (as listed on firedamm.com, November 2026)
- **Launch package:** $1,195 flat: 4 pages, a contact form, Google setup and SEO, live in about a week
- **Custom build:** $300 setup plus $200 a page
- **Add-ons:** contact form $50 · gallery $100 · blog $200 · booking $500 · e-commerce $1,500 · AI chat agent $500 plus $50 a month · Google setup $150 · AI search optimization $300 · languages $300 · writing $100 a page · rush +30%
- **Care plan:** $150 a month · more development $95 an hour
- **Custom business tools** from $750

**Work**
- **LA Domes** (domes.la): an event-dome company's hand-coded site, SEO 100 and Accessibility 100, with an AI concierge and a custom CRM
- **Freedom Star Belize** (freedomstarbelize.com): a lead-generation site for 27.5 bayfront acres in Northern Belize
- **Roll In Host** (rollinhost.com): white-label RV park booking software, live at Mustang Corner with 37 spaces and Stripe payments
- **Dome Desk:** a CRM with job tracking, a prospect library and a P&L module, for a live client

**The human who builds it:** Geoffrey Cooper, a former head rigger on touring productions who taught himself software. He's the builder and your direct contact.
